title: Synthetic hot-water plant: warm-weather lockout (generated by CAMBER)
summary: SYNTHETIC, generated locally by CAMBER (no download, no real building): one hot-water plant's outdoor temperature, burner firing and gas input, hot-water pump status and speed, and loop supply and return temperatures, hourly for eight weeks of late spring with a warm spell, as four plants: locked out at 65 F, left enabled through the warm spell, locked out but with its pump left running, and locked out at 58 F.
teaches: a boiler left enabled through a warm spell, which no open dataset shows
a hot-water pump left running with the boiler locked out
choosing the lockout: where does the plant actually stop firing?
publisher: CAMBER (generated locally by the user's copy)
citation: CAMBER synthetic dataset synthetic-hw-plant-lockout, generator hw_plant_lockout (camber.datasets._synthetic), seed 133. Generated data, not measurements from any building.
timezone: naive generated clock (no DST); hourly samples from 2025-05-05 (a Monday) for 56 days
equipment: 1 hot-water plant (boiler, hot-water pump, loop) as 4 scenario plants

fault_types.boiler_not_locked_out: the boiler (and its pump) left enabled through a warm spell
fault_types.pump_not_locked_out: the hot-water pump left running with the boiler locked out

full.description: all four plants (the same as default)

known_issues: Synthetic: generated by CAMBER's own model of a plant, not measured. It shows what the lockout rules see, not how a real plant behaves; never cite it as evidence about real buildings.
Hourly samples: a firing or a pump run shorter than an hour is invisible.
